extra_vocab.en: to say that something is very important
extra_vocab.note: 簡報結尾，講者用 I'd like to stress that… 提醒聽眾一個重要條件（簽約前法務必須先審閱草案）。這是客氣但很明確的強調說法，常用在會議與簡報中。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 表示「強調」的 stress 是及物動詞，直接接名詞或 that 子句，不加 on；名詞才說 put / lay stress on。

example.en: She always stresses the value of teamwork during meetings.
example.zh: 她在會議中總是強調團隊合作的價值。

example.en: Daily stresses at work can affect how well staff perform.
example.zh: 工作上的日常壓力會影響員工的表現。

example.en: The manager stressed that every report must be submitted by Friday.
example.zh: 經理強調每份報告都必須在星期五前提交。

example.en: Staff feel stressed when deadlines change without warning.
example.zh: 當期限沒有預警就改變時，員工會感到壓力。

example.en: He kept stressing the need to cut costs this quarter.
example.zh: 他一再強調這一季需要降低成本。

example.en: We should stress the importance of quality in our sales pitch.
example.zh: 我們應該在銷售簡報中強調品質的重要性。

example.en: Our proposal will stress the need for faster delivery.
example.zh: 我們的提案將強調需要更快的交貨速度。

example.en: Some employees make more mistakes when they work under stress.
example.zh: 有些員工在壓力下工作時會犯比較多錯。

example.en: The company offers a stress management course every spring.
example.zh: 公司每年春天都開設壓力管理課程。

examples.en: I'd like to stress that the deadline cannot be changed.
examples.zh: 我想強調，截止日期不能更改。

examples.en: Let me stress that safety is our first priority on site.
examples.zh: 容我強調，現場安全是我們的第一優先。

examples.en: I want to stress that the offer is valid until Monday only.
examples.zh: 我想強調，這個優惠只到星期一有效。

similar.diff: 意思幾乎相同，emphasize 稍微正式一點；stress 較短、口語，後面都可接 that 子句。

example.en: The director emphasized that customer feedback will guide our next steps.
example.zh: 主管強調，顧客意見將引導我們的下一步。

similar.diff: highlight 是把重點特別標出來讓人注意，常用於報告與簡報；stress 偏向口頭強調重要性。

example.en: The report highlights the rise in training costs over three years.
example.zh: 這份報告特別指出三年來培訓成本的上升。

confusable.diff: distress 指嚴重的痛苦、焦慮或困境；stress 是一般的壓力，或當動詞表示強調。

example.en: The customer was in distress after losing all the important files.
example.zh: 客戶在遺失所有重要檔案後非常焦急。

confusable.diff: press 是「按壓」或「新聞媒體」，只比 stress 少了開頭的 st-；stress 是強調或壓力。

example.en: The press release stresses that prices will stay the same.
example.zh: 這份新聞稿強調價格將維持不變。

example.en: Sales staff are under pressure to meet the monthly target.
example.zh: 業務人員必須承受達成月目標的壓力。

example.en: The training puts more emphasis on customer service skills.
example.zh: 這項培訓更重視客戶服務技巧。

example.en: Tension rose in the meeting when the budget was discussed.
example.zh: 討論預算時，會議的氣氛變得緊張。

example.en: Please stress the benefits of the new plan in your talk.
example.zh: 請在你的談話中強調新計畫的好處。

example.en: Long working hours can cause a lot of stress for employees.
example.zh: 長工時會讓員工承受許多壓力。

senses.en: to say that something is very important

example.en: The CEO stressed that customer trust matters more than short-term profit.
example.zh: 執行長強調，顧客信任比短期獲利更重要。

senses.en: to make someone feel worried or tense
senses.distinguish: 受詞是「人」，或用 be stressed / stress out 時，是「使有壓力」；後面接 that 子句或抽象名詞時才是「強調」。

example.en: Tight deadlines stress the staff and lower the quality of work.
example.zh: 緊迫的期限讓員工有壓力，也降低了工作品質。
